surface_mechanism_description: The growth-dominated crystallization mechanism of the Sb-rich GeSb8Te films accounts for its ultra-fast switching speed, while GST requires much more time for nucleation due to its nucleation-dominated crystallization mechanism.
evidence: Compared with GST-based device, GeSb8Te-based device exhibits a faster switching speed and reduced reset voltage, which is attributed to the growth-dominated crystallization mechanism of the Sb-rich GeSb8Te films.
